title: Your audience has 16 types
caption:
Your audience isn't one person. It's sixteen types, and each one hears your message differently.

Thinkers want proof. The Heart-led want purpose. Guardians want a guarantee. Makers want to try it. Swipe for what wins each type.

The useful bit: you don't need 16 campaigns. Test four angles (proof, purpose, guarantee, experience) and see who answers.

Send this to a marketer, a founder or anyone who writes copy for a living.

Free test: link in bio (mizaj.pk)
